workloadNotes: A socket.io collaboration server with exactly one HTTP route, so the representative workload is the socket protocol: two concurrent clients exercising every server-side handler (join-room in both the first-in-room and new-user branches, server-broadcast, server-volatile-broadcast, user-follow/unfollow, disconnecting). Driven over the raw engine.io websocket protocol because the repo ships no socket client.
